probe.primary_criterion: Documented model training cutoff (January 2025 for gemini-3.1-flash-lite) is the primary criterion: all test set as_of dates must begin >= cutoff + 2 months (i.e. >= 2025-04-01). Exact price and dated event recall probes serve as secondary empirical checks.
probe.interpretation: Test-set as_of dates must sit post-cutoff. Documented cutoff is primary; empirical probes report both exact index close and dated RBI repo rate events. A refusal is weaker evidence than a wrong answer.
